blocks.title: Learning Navigator & Capacity Cultivator
paragraphs: Dr Aman Jain is a distinguished HR Leader and Talent & Organizational Development subject matter expert with over **16+ years** of experience.
He excels in translating business needs into effective HR strategies, utilizing assessment centres, learning initiatives, and talent management interventions.
Aman currently serves as **CHRO at e2E Rail**, a Railway Infrastructure Company based in Bengaluru. He was previously the Head - Corporate HR at Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited.

blocks.title: Management Researcher
paragraphs: With a **Doctoral degree from IIM Kashipur**, his research explores learning analytics, gamification, and intergenerational learning.

blocks.title: Social Entrepreneur
paragraphs: Beyond his professional achievements, he leads **Zav Foundation** (www.zavfoundation.org), empowering women and youth through skill development.

book.voicesDesc: Here's what they are saying about the book.

featured.name: Kiran Mazumdar Shaw
featured.quote: "From FOMO to JOMO is a book that challenges us to rethink what it means to live a fulfilling life in the age of endless choice and constant connectivity. It is insightful, provocative and practical and makes a compelling case for stepping away from the fear of missing out and discovering the joy of choosing what truly matters. A timely book for a generation of Zillennials that has everything at its fingertips, yet may need to rediscover the value of simply being present."

voices.name: T.V. Mohandas Pai
voices.quote: "We live in a turbulent world driven by social media, which seems to consume our lives. Behind it lie powerful vested interests trying to control our minds and push us in directions they want us to take. The current generation, brought up on social media, seems to live in a different world — devoid of filters, devoid of editing, free for all. In this new world, we need to grow our capacity to judge what narratives we get, to search for facts and truth, so that we remain free citizens capable of individual judgement. From FOMO to JOMO examines the good and the bad of this social media world — and gives this generation, and those who lead them, a language to draw lessons for themselves. This is an important book for our times."

voices.name: Prof. Debolina Dutta
voices.role: Professor, ISB & former VP HR, Schneider Electric
voices.quote: "From FOMO to JOMO offers a rare, rigorous bridge between the lived experience of Gen Z and Zillennial employees and the realities HR leaders must now design for — a cohort projected to dominate the global workforce by 2030. Dr. Aman Jain turns research on digital burnout, algorithmic identity, and disconnection into concrete practice through the Try This prompts, the Frequency Check, and the 30-day JOMO Journal. Grounded equally in storytelling and peer-reviewed evidence, it is indispensable for any leader shaping the workplace this generation will soon define."

voices.name: Priya Venkatesh
voices.quote: "In From FOMO to JOMO, Aman brings together the perspective of a practitioner, a leader, and someone who has watched this generation evolve closely. Timely and deeply relevant, the book invites us to move beyond managing people shaped by the digital age to genuinely understanding them. What I particularly enjoyed is its reflective, experiential format — it makes a case for Zillennials while inviting us to engage with ourselves as we explore their world."

voices.name: Vinay Sirsi
voices.quote: "A much-needed map for young adults authoring their own attention in a hyper-connected world — and for the leaders who employ and manage them. As a father of twin Zillennials trying to figure out the algorithm, I found Aman's guide genuinely pragmatic. It gently nudges every reader to examine their own algorithms, too, through tips and tools you can actually use. A timely, humane book."

recommended.listSubtitle: Essential reads for leadership, personal growth, and professional development

books.title: The Leadership Challenge
books.author: James M. Kouzes & Barry Z. Posner
books.about: A comprehensive guide to leadership excellence that presents five fundamental practices enabling leaders to achieve extraordinary results.

books.title: Dare to Lead
books.author: Brené Brown
books.about: A groundbreaking guide to courageous leadership. Brown explores how vulnerability and courage go hand in hand for leaders who want to build brave, resilient teams.

books.title: Leaders Eat Last
books.author: Simon Sinek
books.about: A powerful examination of why some teams thrive while others struggle. Sinek explores how great leaders create safe environments where people feel valued.
highlights: The biology of trust and cooperation

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.about: A groundbreaking guide to transforming your life through tiny changes. Clear reveals practical strategies for forming good habits and breaking bad ones.

books.title: The Gifts of Imperfection
books.author: Brené Brown
books.about: An inspiring guide to letting go of perfectionism and embracing authenticity. Brown shows how to cultivate courage, compassion, and connection.

books.title: Mindset
books.author: Carol Dweck
books.about: A revolutionary exploration of how our beliefs about abilities shape our lives. Dweck reveals the power of developing a growth mindset for achieving success.

books.title: The Daily Stoic
books.author: Ryan Holiday
books.about: A collection of 366 daily meditations on wisdom, perseverance, and the art of living from Stoic philosophers.

books.title: Start With Why
books.author: Simon Sinek
books.about: A profound exploration of what separates great leaders and organizations from the rest. Sinek introduces the Golden Circle concept.

books.title: The Mountain Is You
books.author: Brianna Wiest
books.about: A transformative guide to self-sabotage and self-mastery. Wiest explores how our biggest obstacles are often within ourselves.

books.title: Big Magic
books.author: Elizabeth Gilbert
books.about: An inspiring manifesto on creativity and living a life driven by curiosity rather than fear. Gilbert shares her wisdom about the mysterious nature of inspiration.

books.title: The Five Dysfunctions of a Team
books.alt: The Five Dysfunctions of a Team
books.author: Patrick Lencioni
books.about: A leadership fable revealing the fundamental causes of organizational politics and team failure. Lencioni provides a powerful model for building cohesive teams.

books.title: Good to Great
books.author: Jim Collins
books.about: A rigorous analysis of what distinguishes truly great companies from good ones. Collins identifies timeless principles that propel companies to extraordinary performance.

books.title: Multipliers
books.author: Liz Wiseman
books.about: A groundbreaking exploration of how great leaders amplify the intelligence and capabilities of those around them. Wiseman contrasts Multipliers who make everyone smarter with Diminishers, providing strategies to unlock genius in organizations.

books.title: Radical Candor
books.author: Kim Scott
books.about: A practical guide to being a better boss through caring personally while challenging directly. Scott provides a framework for giving feedback that builds trust and drives performance, creating teams where people love their work and working together.

books.title: Coaching Agile Teams
books.author: Lyssa Adkins
books.about: The definitive guide for agile coaches helping teams become high-performing. Adkins draws on her experience to show how to coach teams to collaborate better, deliver more, and grow into self-organizing units that thrive in agile environments.

books.title: The 21 Irrefutable Laws of Leadership
books.author: John C. Maxwell
books.about: A comprehensive exploration of timeless leadership principles that have been proven across cultures and organizations. Maxwell distills decades of leadership experience into powerful laws that anyone can apply to increase their influence and effectiveness.

caselets.title:
Practice
Caselets
caselets.description: Bite-sized case studies from real transformations, ready to download and explore with your teams.

cards.title: Scaling Culture During Hypergrowth
cards.description: Rapidly onboarding over 500 employees in 9 months, risking the dilution of core collaborative and innovative culture and leading to slow productivity ramp-up.
cards.outcome: Improved the average ramp-up time for new hires by 34% and increased new hire satisfaction scores by 40 points through a 'Blended Onboarding Journey'.

cards.title: Reviving Engagement in a Distributed Workforce
cards.description: Combatting plummeting employee engagement and soaring attrition across 37 distributed locations post-pandemic, impacting guest experience.
cards.outcome: A 20% jump in the eNPS score and an 18% decrease in attrition rates within six months through a multi-channel 'Revive & Thrive' engagement initiative.

cards.title: Building a Leadership Pipeline
cards.description: Addressing a looming leadership crisis due to planned retirements by systematically identifying and grooming emerging leaders across 14 plants.
cards.outcome: Created a visible pipeline resulting in 25% of identified candidates being promoted and 90% of critical roles having at least one groomed successor.

cards.title: Digital HR Transformation Blueprint
cards.description: Struggling with a fragmented HR tech stack across six geographies, leading to poor employee experience and inconsistent people data.
cards.outcome: Developed a future-state Digital HR Transformation Blueprint, securing full executive funding and achieving a 15% reduction in HR administrative queries post-phase-one.

cards.title: Designing a High-Potential Program
cards.description: Losing top performers in critical functions (merchandising and supply chain) due to a lack of clear career paths and structured development for high-potential employees (HiPos).
cards.outcome: Increased HiPo retention by 18% and boosted the internal fill rate for critical mid-senior roles from 40% to 65% within the first year through the 'HiPo Accelerator Program'.

cards.title: Embedding Coaching at Scale
cards.description: Driving a culture of safety and customer-centricity and embedding sustainable behavioral change at scale across a massive, distributed frontline workforce.
cards.outcome: Launched a 'Coaching Guild' program, leading to a 15% reduction in safety incidents, a 25% drop in customer complaints, and a measurable productivity lift.
